entities.name: Strother
entities.description: A lazy, hungry, smelly dwarf soldier on Shiv.

entities.name: Borg
entities.description: A lazy, hungry, smelly orc soldier on Shiv.

entities.name: Elam
entities.description: A lazy, hungry, smelly goblin soldier on Shiv.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A region of Dominaria where the trio lived.

entities.name: Cometia
entities.description: An oasis in a deep meteor crater on Shiv, home to elves and druids.

entities.name: Snap
entities.description: A tiny twig dragon who destroyed the serpent generator and saved Cometia.

entities.name: Dirk the Dastardly
entities.description: The maker of a serpent generator.

entities.name: Lord Ugliness
entities.description: An orcish noble and warlord on the front lines against a zombie army.

entities.name: Mutter Makree
entities.description: The maker of another Serpent Generator.

entities.name: Lord of the Pit
entities.description: A demon who demanded tribute and ate Lord Ugliness and his sergeant.

entities.name: Serpent generator
entities.description: A machine that produces snakes, eaten by the Lord of the Pit.

events.summary: Strother, Borg and Elam flood Cometia with snakes from a serpent generator, killing many defenders.
events.quote: They flooded Cometia with snakes, killing many of its defenders

events.summary: Snap goes into the generator, destroying it and saving Cometia; the trio is reassigned to the zombie slough.
events.quote: Snap went into the crack and then into the generator, destroying it and saving Cometia

events.summary: Working for Lord Ugliness, the trio finds the Serpent Generator made by Mutter Makree.
events.quote: they found the Serpent Generator made by Mutter Makree

events.summary: A Lord of the Pit demands tribute; the trio feed it snakes and it collects zombie scalps for them.
events.quote: The trio fed snakes to the demon

events.summary: The Lord of the Pit eats Lord Ugliness and his sergeant as tribute, then eats the generator.
events.quote: the Lord of the Pit returned from battle just then and ate the warlord and his sergeant as his tribute

events.summary: The trio redirect the demon to the next day's banquet and flee.
events.quote: they redirected the demon to the banquet feast that would be held the next day

relations.quote: Strother, Borg, and Elam were a trio of lazy, hungry and smelly soldiers
